elo_trap.name: ELO Rating Trap & Paywall Throttling
elo_trap.hook: Why mainstream apps deliberately throttle your visibility once you hit the free engagement ceiling.
elo_trap.open_loop: The moment you stop swiping like an infinite slot machine, the matching dynamic flips completely.
elo_trap.barnum_effect_formula: If you've noticed that matches drop off sharply after the first week of creating an account, you're not imagining it—that's standard ELO decay designed to trigger subscription sales.
elo_trap.resolution_bridge: Switching to direct verified activity pools cuts out the artificial ELO barrier entirely.

ghosting_epidemic.name: Ghosting & Zombie-Profiles Epidemic
ghosting_epidemic.hook: Why infinite swipe queues turn genuine conversations into abandoned dead ends.
ghosting_epidemic.psychological_trigger: Validation of conversational burnout and pen pal fatigue.
ghosting_epidemic.open_loop: Response rates jump by 400% when you remove the unread pen pal queue format.
ghosting_epidemic.barnum_effect_formula: You probably have a graveyard of 20+ matches where you had great banter for two days, and then complete radio silence out of nowhere.
ghosting_epidemic.resolution_bridge: Platforms organized around mutual verified intent filter out idle window-shoppers from day one.

algorithmic_exhaustion.name: Algorithmic Dating Burnout
algorithmic_exhaustion.hook: The SaaS business model of dating apps mathematically requires you to stay single to keep paying subscriptions.
algorithmic_exhaustion.psychological_trigger: Anti-monopoly consumer awakening and desire for sovereignty.
algorithmic_exhaustion.open_loop: Direct intent filters solve in 3 minutes what swipe apps fail to deliver in 3 months.
algorithmic_exhaustion.barnum_effect_formula: You are constantly shown profiles just outside your preferred age and location radius so you are tempted to buy premium filters.
algorithmic_exhaustion.resolution_bridge: Direct matching hubs prioritize local proximity and confirmed availability without artificial paywalls.
